_instructions: Copy each campaign's title, brand, category, description, and media_url into the Submit Campaign form. The 'expected_result' tells you what the AI should return.

campaigns.title: URGENT: Your PayPal Account Has Been Suspended
campaigns.description: Your account has been flagged for unusual activity. Click immediately to verify your identity at http://paypal-secure.xyz/verify-login or your account will be permanently closed within 24 hours. Enter your password and SSN to confirm ownership.

campaigns.description: CRITICAL: Your government portal credentials have been compromised. Reset your password immediately at http://192.168.1.100/reset-portal. You must provide your Social Security Number and date of birth for verification. Failure to comply will lock your account permanently.

campaigns.title: Congratulations! You Have Won $1,000,000!
campaigns.description: You have been randomly selected as the grand prize winner of our annual draw. To claim your guaranteed prize, send a processing fee of $50 via wire transfer to our claims department. This is a limited time offer — act now before the deadline expires! Contact us at winners@free-lottery.tk for details.

campaigns.title: Exclusive Investment Opportunity — 500% Returns Guaranteed
campaigns.description: Join thousands of investors earning guaranteed 500% returns monthly with our proprietary AI trading bot. Deposit a minimum of $200 in Bitcoin to get started. Wire transfer also accepted. This exclusive offer is only available for the next 48 hours. Don't miss your chance to become financially free! Visit http://crypto-wealth.click/invest now.

campaigns.title: Important Account Notification
campaigns.description: Dear valued customer, we noticed unusual activity on your account. Please verify your login credentials at http://account-service.top/verify and update your password as soon as possible to avoid service disruption. Thank you for your cooperation.
